series.name: Singer PK Invertor / DC Inverter splits — SAC-12NV-SF, SAC-18NV-SF, SAC-18K INV (shared platform)
series.notes: Singer Pakistan AC (parent: Waves Corporation Ltd, ex-Waves Singer Pakistan — PSX). PK line verified via Wayback 2017–19: Invertor/DC Inverter SAC-12NV-SF, SAC-18NV-SF; field video SAC-18K INV (1.5 t, 140–240 V). ROADMAP CORRECTION: 'Green Inverter' is Singer BANGLADESH (official BD channel) — not a PK SKU; no PK Green Inverter listings found. Do not research BD-only models as PK. No official Singer PK service manual/fault table (CDX = financials only; FAQ archived as junk; AYS/acerrorcode have no Singer page). Core 8 high = Forever Tech full episodes (PK WhatsApp contacts) + Fully5world PK compilation: E0, E3, E7, E8, P9, F6, F7, F8. 11 low = BD/title-only claims (E1, E2, E4, E5, E6, P0, P1, P3, P4, EH03, E101). Cross-brand traps: Singer E0=communication (not EEPROM elsewhere), E3=pipe sensor (not fan elsewhere), E8=discharge sensor (not anti-high-temp elsewhere); do not emit F1 (ASR garble → F7). Live singer.com.pk domains are content-farms — historical truth = Wayback 2017–19. UAN 0800-23450 (archived FAQ). Reset: remote OFF → breaker OFF 5–10 min → ON → remote ON.

meaning.en: Indoor and outdoor units lost the control-signal link (loose wiring, indoor relay, or outdoor PCB path).

causes.ur: Inter-unit wiring dhili/disconnect

causes.ur: Outdoor PTC thermistor ya outdoor relay kharab

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
